data.body: OPERATOR-RATIFIED DECISION (2026-08-04): wire the EXISTING documented config keys into botocore's client Config on the Bedrock path — retries={'max_attempts': llm_retry_max_attempts, 'mode': 'adaptive'} plus read_timeout/connect_timeout both from the configured timeout (timeout_s / REBAR_LLM_TIMEOUT), mirroring the Anthropic path's single httpx.Timeout(timeout_s). No new config keys are invented. Semantics: botocore max_attempts counts TOTAL attempts (initial + retries), the same counting as tenacity stop_after_attempt(N) on the Anthropic path; N<=1 disables retry (fail-fast). llm_retry_max_wait_s has no botocore equivalent and is deliberately NOT mapped. Strict TDD: RED behavioral tests first (fake/spy boto3 session asserting the client is created with matching botocore Config), then wire. Implementation: build the boto3 client in build_bedrock_provider (boto3.session.Session + session.client('bedrock-runtime', config=Config(...))) and pass it via BedrockProvider(bedrock_client=...).
